slices.focus: Leadership publicly recognizes Kelli's turnaround work; she is asked to present to board finance members.
slices.summary: At the fall leadership review, Monica presents Kelli's dashboard history, showing how payroll nerves have cooled and vendor hold calls have decreased. Kelli is asked to present the turnaround approach to board finance members. She plans a ladder-of-stages slide showing the progression from defect tracking to rule-change detection to prevention-onboarding, and identifies three nonnegotiables to prevent backsliding: aging review rhythm, ownership on stalled items, and front-end error accountability.
